g.text: Document frequency (df) = number of songs containing a word; “day” has df = 3.

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #142d4e

g.text: TF-IDF = count × [1 + ln(4 / (1 + df))], then divide each row by its Euclidean length.

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #142d4e

g.text: Darker cells mean larger values within each matrix. Unigrams are single words; order is not represented.
